ticket.title: Reject postings into a closed period
ticket.why: Entries can be posted into a period that has already been closed, which silently changes books that accountants treat as final. Two tenants have reported closed-period balances drifting after month end.
ticket.what: In `src/ledger/services/posting.py`, `post_entry` looks up the entry's period through the store and raises `PeriodClosedError` (a `LedgerError` subclass with code `period_closed`) before anything is written when that period is closed. In `src/ledger/api/router.py`, `error_response` maps `PeriodClosedError` to HTTP 409. No schema change. The CLI, which shares the service, reports the error as `error: period_closed` and exits 1.
acceptance: `post_entry` raises `PeriodClosedError` when the entry's period is closed and writes nothing.
Posting to a closed period over the API returns 409 with error code `period_closed`.
Posting to an open period behaves exactly as before.
`python -m ledger.cli post --period 2024-01 --amount 5` exits 1 and prints `error: period_closed`.

commands.text:
$ python -m ledger.cli post --period 2024-01 --amount 5
error: period_closed: period 2024-01 is closed; nothing was written
exit status 1
